title: One short idea per knowledge statement
statement: Keep each generated knowledge statement short and about one idea, since people trimmed the long ones and split the combined ones.
example: About 20 of 160 comments on generated knowledge nodes record trimming an over-long statement, and three record splitting one fact into two.
detail: In the human checks of an AP history course's model-generated knowledge nodes, about 20 of 160 comments record trimming an over-long statement, with the original kept and marked 'og (too long)'. Three record a manual addition that split the previous fact into two, and two more facts were split in the same checks, one into two and one into four.
